question.text: In the MCX iCOMDEX Composite Index for 2025, the approximate weight of Crude Oil is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per workbook p.39, in the MCX iCOMDEX Composite Index for 2025 Crude Oil has approximately 24% weight. The Trap: 30% was Crude Oil's weight in an earlier composition. 16% is Natural Gas and 22% is Gold per the 2025 weights. These weights are adjusted during periodic rebalancing. Note: Read constituent weights from the 2025 column on p.39 rather than mixing in older or different commodities' weights.
